verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents the CUDA Toolkit as its GPU-compute environment, with a compiler, runtime, libraries, Nsight profiling tools and NGC containers. The RTX 5080 product page pitches the card for development across PyTorch and other inference backends, and community compute benchmarks show the 5080 running compute workloads. However, no cited CUDA document names the RTX 5080 (or its Blackwell compute capability) as a supported target, so the story's core requirement is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing that includes the RTX 5080, and hands-on reports of building and shipping CUDA workloads on this card.
